overview: LAROO tackles heavy-tailed Q-value bias in offline-to-online reinforcement learning by adaptively modeling bias with Laplace-distributed noise and re-centering it via conservative ensemble estimates, enhancing training stability and fine-tuning performance.

modules.name: D4RL Data Loader & Replay Buffer
modules.description: Loads D4RL benchmark datasets, manages separate offline and online replay buffers, and implements the balanced half-offline half-online sampling strategy for training batches.

modules.name: Ensemble Q-Network Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the multiple Q-value networks required for the conservative ensemble strategy and defines the forward pass logic for state-action value estimation.

modules.name: Policy Network Architecture
modules.description: Defines the Actor network for action selection, supporting continuous control for locomotion tasks and latent-variable policies for sparse reward environments.

modules.name: Laplace Noise Model & Variance Estimator
modules.description: Implements the adaptive updating of the Laplace scale parameter using the MSE-best biased estimator (MBBE) on TD-errors to capture the heavy-tailed characteristics of Q-bias.

modules.name: Robust Q-Loss Function
modules.description: Implements the derived Laplace-based robust loss function and its bounded gradient computation to replace the standard L2 loss, effectively down-weighting extreme Q-value errors.

modules.name: Conservative Ensemble Q-Target
modules.description: Calculates the Bellman target by taking the minimum over a random subset of the ensemble Q-networks to mitigate positive Q-bias and re-center the bias distribution.

modules.name: Critic Update Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates the Q-network parameter updates by integrating the Laplace noise model, the robust loss function, and the conservative ensemble targets.

modules.name: Actor Update Engine
modules.description: Implements the policy update mechanism, handling deterministic policy gradient updates or latent-variable advantage-weighted updates depending on the specific backbone algorithm.

modules.name: Distribution Shift Analyzer
modules.description: Calculates distance metrics between online samples and offline data to analyze the non-uniform distribution shift contributing to heavy-tailed Q-bias.

modules.name: Offline Pre-training Engine
modules.description: Manages the initial training phase using standard offline reinforcement learning algorithms to obtain the pretrained agents required for the online fine-tuning stage.

modules.name: Online Fine-tuning Engine
modules.description: Executes the main LAROO training loop, handling online environment interaction, data collection, and the iterative updates of both the Q-networks and policy network.

modules.name: Q-Bias & Tail Statistics Calculator
modules.description: Computes true Q-values via Monte Carlo rollouts and evaluates Q-bias statistics including mean, variance, kurtosis, and tail index for heavy-tailed distribution analysis.

modules.name: Training Stability Evaluator
modules.description: Implements the Normalized Cumulative Performance Drop (NCD) metric and variance tracking to quantify performance degradation and oscillation during the fine-tuning process.

modules.name: Statistical Testing & Comparison
modules.description: Performs Bootstrap resampling mean difference testing to evaluate the statistical significance of performance improvements over baseline methods.

modules.name: Visualization & Reporting
modules.description: Generates analytical visualizations including Q-bias histograms, Laplace/Gaussian density comparisons, training curves, and scatter plots for bias versus distribution shift distance.
